speed.prompt: Output only Python code. Implement def merge_intervals(intervals): for a list of [start, end] integer pairs. Return a new sorted list with all overlapping or touching intervals merged. Do not mutate the input. Include type hints, a docstring, and at least six assert-based examples after the function.

Return only valid compact JSON, no Markdown. Produce an array of exactly 40 objects. Object i has exactly three keys in this order: id, label, square. id runs from 1 through 40, label is item-XX with a two-digit id, and square is id multiplied by itself.

Solve this carefully: seven aisles each receive exactly one twelfth of a 144-crate shipment, then 5 additional crates are placed in inspection. Explain and independently verify the calculation in at least 20 numbered lines. End with exactly FINAL: 89.

Write exactly 12 paragraphs about debugging a distributed tracing pipeline. Each paragraph must be at least 35 words and must start with P1: through P12: in order. Cover instrumentation, propagation, sampling, clocks, queues, retries, storage, query plans, privacy, cost, incident response, and verification, one topic per paragraph.

quality.prompt: Return only the integer result of 487 * 39 - 2764.
Return only valid JSON with exactly these keys: total, ascending. total is the sum of 91, 17, 63, and 28. ascending is those four integers sorted from smallest to largest.
Return the integers 1 through 100 in order, separated by commas. No other text.

Extract the records into a JSON array ordered by ticket. Return JSON only. Text: Ticket C-17 owner Mina severity high. Ticket A-04 owner Luis severity low. Ticket B-09 owner Noor severity medium. Each object must have exactly ticket, owner, severity.
Use the calculator tool to multiply 37 by 23. Do not answer in prose.

Seven aisles each receive exactly one twelfth of a 144-crate shipment, then 5 additional crates are placed in inspection. Explain briefly and end with FINAL: 89.
